scheme_name: National Awards For Outstanding Services In The Field Of Prevention Of Alcoholism And Substance (Drug) Abuse: Best Integrated Rehabilitation Centre For Addicts (IRCA) For Providing Rehabilitation Services To Alcoholics And Drug Users
other_conditions: Nomination must be made in writing by an authorized agency or person; self‑nominations are not accepted
Applicants who have received the award cannot be considered for the next three award cycles
Only nominations or recommendations from authorized agencies or persons will be considered
Non‑profit institutions such as NGOs, trusts, societies or community‑based organisations are eligible
Institutions must have been working in the field of prevention of alcoholism and substance abuse for at least five years

Institutions should create regular awareness among youth, work with addicts to address stigma, support addicts and families for treatment and rehabilitation, provide treatment facilities for marginalized people, provide employee training on alcohol and drug issues, and actively network with NGOs and community‑based organisations
benefits_summary: The award includes a citation, a memento and a cash prize of ₹2,00,000.
